About our hospital

Healthcare with dignity and compassion

Kailash Hospital is located near Anaj Mandi in Balaji Colony, Farrukhnagar, Gurugram. Our aim is to make healthcare information and access easier for individuals and families in the surrounding community.

Every patient deserves attention, respect and clear guidance. Please contact our team for current doctor schedules, service availability and appointment information.
